summary: Correct the direction of movement in the translation
before: I have come to bring dinner
after: I am going to bring dinner
rationale: The quoted k-azzí corresponds to corpus Kazzi; the edition translates "Ich gehe und bringe". She is going to her husband, rather than reporting that she has come.

summary: New sense 1b: in Berührung kommen, auf etwas auftreffen (mit b-; ʕal);

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: in Berührung kommen, auf etwas auftreffen (mit b-; ʕal);

rationale: A thorn contacting an arm and hoof touching felt denote physical contact, rather than encountering a person or landmark. Yoke pieces also meet physically.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (JTM 5.3/8)

data.turoyo: komər azze. azze ʕal i nurayo mhalaxle, komər laqi u məṣarbəṣono du lalyo w du imomo
data.translation: Er marschierte los. Er ging auf das Licht zu, da traf er den Trenner von Nacht und Tag.

rationale: Thin I.1 Preterit Intransitive; unmarked postverbal encountered person.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (63/318)

data.turoyo: I ḥurmayḏi ste aṯyo bu šuqo, kokərxola ʕal laḥmo. Ono w hiya laqina bu šuqo l ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Da kam meine Frau auf den Markt und suchte nach Brot. Ich und sie trafen einander auf dem Markt.

rationale: Fourth I.1 Preterit Intransitive including the two existing examples; unambiguous first-person plural with reciprocal l-.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (70/239)

data.turoyo: Əmmi: "Ya baba walla, lo laqina l darmono, ḥatta d moṭina l ʕaynux."
data.translation: "Bei Gott, Vater, wir sind auf kein Heilmittelgestoßen, das wir für deine Augenhätten bringen können."

rationale: Fifth I.1 Preterit Intransitive; negative encounter of an inanimate sought remedy, with l-.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (113/209)

data.turoyo: Qayəm azzele l Usuf Pelawan, laqile qum walaye, məlle: "Šlomo aʕlux!" — "Ahla w sahla, ʕal aʕ ʕayne!"
data.translation: Er ging zu Jusuf Pelawan. Er traf ihn vor einer Stadt. - Heil über dich! - Willkommen, auf die Augen! -

rationale: Unusual clear 3sg laqi-le target suffix; does not create a transitive Preterit box.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NI Three kinds of death/2)

data.turoyo: Kobe laf+faqire, kobe lu+ʕulmo. U+ḥa dkoloqele, kobele parčaye.
data.translation: He gives to the poor, he gives to people. Everyone who meets him, he gives him a portion.
data.ref: MAC NI Three kinds of death/2

rationale: New explicit Infectum l-suffix frame in a self-contained encounter-and-gift context.

evidence.cite: MAC NI Three kinds of death/2

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (6/77)

data.turoyo: ʕAl hayo bəṯr kəzze, kḥoze, kloqe bazərgan, d mawbele i səsto, at tawre.
data.translation: Daraufhin, später, geht er und findet, trifft auf einen Karawanenkaufmann. Der will ihm das Pferd und die Ochsen abnehmen.

rationale: Unmarked postverbal counterpart in Infectum; documents government missing from all existing examples.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (MAC Ishaq Material culture/96)

data.turoyo: Bi+ḥarayto gloqən ha hawxa bəḥḏoḏe hani; laltaḥ gmiḥəs aʕlayye ḥawlo. A+tre tawrani bu+šəklawo gmitawsri bgawe du+niro.
data.translation: Finally, these ones would meet one another here like so; underneath, a rope would be fastened to them. That way, these two bulls would be tied inside the yoke.

rationale: New physical-contact subsense; inanimate components are joined in a yoke.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (107/36)

data.turoyo: W me d qayimat, me d azzolux, lo kowe, d dorat šlomo aʕlayye, lo kowe, d howat paya, hul d u sum di səsto di ǧwaniyayḏux, d loqe ʕal u kulav taḥte di kone.
data.translation: Und wenn du hinreitest, darfst du ihnen nicht den Gruß entbieten und nicht absitzen, ehe nicht der Huf deiner Stute den Filz unter die Zelte berührt!

rationale: New contact subsense with ʕal: hoof must touch felt before dismounting.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 83/96)

data.turoyo: Qayəm u taʕlo, mamṭele i kaččəke w aṯi. Malqele u ʕmiro daṭ ṭayre, aṯi lu ṣaydo dann arnuwe, əšme u Simər yo, u aġa daṭ ṭayre.
data.translation: Der Fuchs machte sich auf und nahm das Mädchen mit sich. Unterwegs traf er mit dem Fürsten der Vögel zusammen, der auf die Hasenjagd ging; dessen Käme ist Simer, der Fürst der Vögel.

rationale: Thin III.1 Preterit, direct NP counterpart; retain contextual subject ambiguity as question.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 85/116)

data.turoyo: Malqalle lu pələng, qṭəlle u taʕlo w šqəlle i kačke.
data.translation: aber unterwegs begegneten ihm die Panther, die erschlugen ihn und nahmen das Mädchen weg.

rationale: Third III.1 Preterit; plural malqalle contrasts with singular malqele.

summary: I has b-, l-, unmarked nominal and pronominal counterparts, with b-/l- reciprocal ḥḏoḏe. A locative phrase such as bu darbo must not be counted as government of the encountered person.
Unmarked nominals occur in both Preterit Intransitive and Infectum, not only a single detached-topic construction. Preserve one encounter sense and record coding variation.
III is attested as meeting with a direct nominal counterpart; the evidence does not itself establish causative meaning. Reciprocal semantics can obscure who is grammatical agent in PrS 83/96.
Singular verbs before conjoined encounter participants contrast with plural laqən/laqina; b ḥḏoḏe is reciprocal coding, not evidence of Detransitive.
Three compact records lack their own verse. The first 97/112 gloqe is recoverable from its full companion; both 53/63 records remain unverified.
Supply the full verse and edition translation for the two compact 53/63 records; their reported Infectum analyses have not been independently verified.
Confirm no+laqutu (MAC Hanna Dewo/215) as Preterit Intransitive; its a-vocalism and reply Laqina support this over the reader's Infectum.
Confirm segmentation of laqəlle (JTM 5.1/32; 95/270) and Laqəbbe (PrS 71/126): plural plus counterpart suffix versus another paradigm. The published additions use clearer laqile (113/209).
Does III malqele/malqalle differ systematically in valency from I with l-/zero counterparts? At PrS 83/96 which participant is subject?
Check edition numbering for the inherited prs 7/11,49/37, prs 9/35 and prs 90/11 versus PrS 2/20,3/22,35/28. Text matches do not establish citation error.
105/103 German contains the corrupt span eindorrenden Granatapfelbaums; supply a verified translation before using it as a contact example.
For 92/51, is ġalabe kurfe a core unmarked counterpart or detached topic? Other unmarked clauses already justify expanded government without a new numbered construction sense.
Correct German 'den' to 'denn'
rationale: The interrogative particle is denn. The supplied edition translation at 6/38 reads "Warum weinst du denn?".

summary: Encountered entities include rivers, buildings, countries, remedies and abstract evil; these remain encounter sense 1. Animate animal subjects are likewise not a new sense.
